39. Network Troubleshooting and
Diagnostic Commands

Diagnose failures from local connectivity and name resolution through transport, TLS and HTTP;
each diagnostic gives limited evidence.
මුලින් local network සහ DNS බලන්න. ඊළඟට TCP connection, TLS සහ HTTP status බලලා failure
A frontend reports that its API is unreachable.

Check address / route Resolve DNS Test connection Inspect TLS / HTTP · Read the diagram: Check address / route → Resolve DNS → Test connection → Inspect TLS / HTTP. · මුලින් local network සහ DNS බලන්න. ඊළඟට TCP connection, TLS සහ HTTP status බලලා failure එක තිJයන · layer එක හඳුනාගන්න.

ip route
nslookup example.com
curl -v --connect-timeout 5 https://example.com
Expected result: Output helps locate failures; an ICMP ping failure alone does not prove service failure.

Q: What does HTTP 500 tell you?
A: An HTTP response reached the client and indicates server-side failure, not necessarily its root cause.
